summary: East kerb backing onto dense bush, no homes within 40 m.

drivers.seclusion: Dense bush on the east side and a vacant gravel lot opposite; nearest mapped buildings are commercial 14 m or more away, and the houses seen in imagery sit beyond 55 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed lane with a narrow edge before bush; room to stop is tight, so a van may sit partly in the lane.
drivers.traffic: Dead-quiet side street off Witton Road; arterial noise from the motorway just east.
drivers.convention: A few cars park at the north end only; no cars on this stretch, so a van may stand out slightly.

flags: Low-lying: about 5.5 m elevation, Witton Creek 26 m away, flood-prone
Noise from the arterial to the east
No Stopping Any Time sign at the Witton Road end
Kerb-side room looks narrow beside the bush
sun_shade: Bush shades the section from the east and the morning sun; open to the west afternoon sun.
cannot_judge: Width of verge under the bush edge

best_section.where: East kerb of Rennies Road, south of the houses, beside the bush strip by the motorway
